scope: One complete Vox-only imported-WPT cohort. Reported-subtest rates exclude tests that do not report and do not establish all-tests-pass conformance.

comparison.method: Match exact (file ID, subtest name). Collapse identical duplicate results only for this matched comparison; retain all executions in raw totals and archives.

r14_guard.metric: sampled sum of process-tree RSS; shared pages may be counted twice

fixture_pin_limitation: The runner records the Ladybird commit and native hashes; it does not continuously hash all fixture resources.
limitations: r13 used six shards with chunks of 50; r14 uses one serialized runner with chunks of 100.
The static server lacks wptserve Python handlers and full multi-origin/HTTPS support.
Host load rose from [10.64, 12.82, 14.23] to [175.11, 134.41, 81.99] on 18 CPUs; deadline outcomes are sensitive to contention.
NO_HARNESS means no harness request or alive signal before the deadline; it is not proof that author script never executed.
The runner records CRASH but does not retain each browser process return code. Browser logs preserve available signal traces.
The source build was dirty. Focused source checks establish the later changes independently of the pinned r14 binary.
